66E.title: Punishment for violation of privacy
66E.description: Whoever intentionally or knowingly captures, publishes or transmits the image of a private area of any person without consent, violates privacy with imprisonment up to 3 years or fine up to 2 lakh rupees.

66D.title: Punishment for cheating by personation by using computer resource
66D.description: Whoever by means of any communication device or computer resource cheats by personating shall be punished with imprisonment up to 3 years and fine.

67.title: Punishment for publishing or transmitting obscene material in electronic form
67.description: Punishment for publishing or transmitting obscene material in electronic form on first conviction with imprisonment up to 3 years and fine up to 5 lakh rupees.

67A.title: Punishment for publishing or transmitting of material containing sexually explicit act in electronic form
67A.description: Punishment for publishing or transmitting sexually explicit material in electronic form with imprisonment up to 5 years and fine up to 10 lakh rupees on first conviction.

it_rules_2021.title: Information Technology (Intermediary Guidelines and Digital Media Ethics Code) Rules, 2021

3_2_b.title: 24-Hour Removal of Non-Consensual Morphed/Intimate Imagery
3_2_b.description: Intermediary must within 24 hours from receipt of complaint remove or disable access to content exposing the private area of an individual, showing full or partial nudity, or depicting an individual in any sexual act or conduct, or any morphed content or artificial non-consensual depiction.

77.title: Voyeurism
77.description: Any person who captures or disseminates images of a woman engaging in a private act in circumstances where she would usually have the expectation of privacy.

308.title: Extortion
308.description: Intentionally putting any person in fear of injury and dishonestly inducing delivery of property or valuable security (blackmail).

351.title: Criminal Intimidation
351.description: Threatening injury to person, reputation or property to cause alarm or force any act.
